units.source_text: 我日漸消沉，在為靜子的雜誌畫每個月的連載漫畫《金太郎與小太郎的冒險》時，

en.t: I sank deeper day by day, and while I was drawing the monthly serial comic The Adventures of Kintaro and Kotaro for Shizuko's magazine,

units.source_text: 突然想起老家的親人，倍感孤單，畫筆無法動彈，低頭落淚。

en.t: I suddenly remembered my family back home, felt unbearably lonely, found my pen unable to move, and bowed my head as tears fell.

units.source_text: 適逢此時，能帶給我些許安慰的，就只有茂子。

en.t: At such times, the only one who gave me even a little comfort was Shigeko.

units.source_text: 她當時已毫不避諱地叫我「爸爸」了。

en.t: By then, she was calling me Daddy without the slightest hesitation.

units.source_text: 「爸爸，聽說對著神祈禱，神什麼都會答應，這是真的嗎？」

en.t: Daddy, is it true that if you pray to God, God will grant you anything?
I was the one who wanted to offer such a prayer.

units.source_text: 神啊，請賜我冷靜的意志！

en.t: God, please grant me a calm will!

units.source_text: 請讓我知曉人類的本質！

en.t: Please let me know the true nature of human beings!

units.source_text: 人們相互排擠也不算罪過嗎？！

en.t: Is it not a sin for people to push one another aside?!
Please grant me the mask of anger!

units.source_text: 茂子的許願，神什麼都會答應的。

en.t: God will grant anything Shigeko wishes for.
But for Daddy, it will not work.
